title: Royal Twisted — Spiral Keep
description: A 2–10 contestant survival run around Spiral Keep: jump cyan rods, hold duck under coral rods, recover from setbacks and compete for the crown. Includes seeded replay, jump/duck practice rhythms, full standings and persistent sound/access preferences.
